descriptionChirho: The Canaanite goddess Asherah, consort of El/Baal, as an object of illicit worship in Israel; references where the name denotes the deity herself rather than (or as metonymy for) her cult object.

A wooden cult object (pole, stylized tree, or carved image) erected at high places and beside altars in honor of the goddess Asherah; the physical artifact that kings of Judah and Israel set up or destroyed. Includes singular and plural forms (אֲשֵׁרִים / אֲשֵׁרוֹת) with all grammatical inflections.
